chunks: The palsy of death will surely come. This is what you wished to avert.

key_terms.سَكْرَةُ الْمَوْتِ: The palsy or intoxication of death

ai.seo_question: What does the 'palsy of death' mean in Surah Qaf?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the term 'sakrah' (intoxication/palsy) is interpreted as the overwhelming, disorienting reality of death that strips away worldly illusions, confirming the truth of the Hereafter. This verse serves as a stern warning to those who arrogantly avoided the reality of their mortality, emphasizing that death is not an escape but the ultimate confrontation with divine justice.
